finding.label: GAP
finding.rationale: Two signals are produced but consumed by no COP: insights.no_oversight (actions taken without human oversight) and insights.lockfile (dependency or lockfile changes). Both bear on governance questions: whether required approval or oversight was present, and whether dependencies or supply chain changed. The natural owner of insights.no_oversight is policy_enforcement, whose missing_required_approval metric is not yet computed; behavior_analytics, which already reads oversight.fast_approvals, is the alternative. The natural owner of insights.lockfile is agent_lifecycle_management, via tool_version_change, with risk_mitigation as the alternative. The 16 edge differences are mostly consumed_not_declared, meaning COPs read upstream COPs that the declared graph omits; two edges are declared but not consumed. The declared graph is therefore not an accurate map of actual data flow. The upstream audit_traceability COMPLETE finding concerns traceability of audited records and is not evidence of coverage. Confidence is moderate because no confirmed gap records exist and the tools give no impact data for the two metrics. Telemetry is not degraded.
